moments.title: Glasgow Commonwealth Games Closes
moments.blurb: The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games conclude tomorrow, Sunday August 2nd, after 11 days of competition where Welsh athletes, particularly in cycling, secured multiple medals.

angles.name: Wales' success
angles.copy: What a performance from Team Wales at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow! As the Games wrap up tomorrow, celebrate our incredible athletes, especially the cyclists bringing home the medals.

angles.name: Games wrap up
angles.copy: It's the final day of the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow tomorrow! Who were your standout stars and most memorable moments from the past 11 days of sporting action?

moments.title: Sex Pistols play Cardiff Castle
moments.blurb: Punk legends Sex Pistols, featuring Frank Carter, headline Cardiff Castle tonight, August 1st, marking 50 years of punk music.

angles.name: Punk in Cardiff
angles.copy: Cardiff Castle is going full punk tonight! The Sex Pistols, with Frank Carter on vocals, are celebrating 50 years of punk right here in the capital.

angles.name: Punk anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty years of punk rock! The Sex Pistols are bringing their iconic sound to Cardiff Castle tonight. Who's ready for some anarchy in the UK?

moments.title: Two Door Cinema Club in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Indie favourites Two Door Cinema Club play Cardiff Castle tomorrow, August 2nd, on their 15th Anniversary Tour with special guests Friendly Fires.

angles.name: Cardiff gig
angles.copy: Get ready for indie anthems! Two Door Cinema Club take over Cardiff Castle tomorrow night for their 15th Anniversary Tour. Who's going?

angles.name: Indie anniversary
angles.copy: Celebrating 15 years of Two Door Cinema Club! They're hitting Cardiff Castle tomorrow with Friendly Fires. What's your favourite track of theirs?

moments.title: Summer in Nashville comes to Swansea
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest touring country festival, Summer in Nashville, arrives at Singleton Park in Swansea tomorrow, August 2nd, featuring a huge stage of music and tribute acts.

angles.name: Country in Swansea
angles.copy: Yeehaw! Summer in Nashville is bringing the best of country music to Singleton Park in Swansea tomorrow. Who's ready for a hoedown?

angles.name: Country festival
angles.copy: Grab your cowboy hats! The Summer in Nashville festival hits Swansea tomorrow. Expect country legends and new acts direct from the USA.

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival kicks off
moments.blurb: The Boardmasters Festival, combining surfing, skateboarding, and music, begins on Wednesday, August 5th, in Cornwall.

angles.name: Cornwall festival
angles.copy: Cornwall is gearing up for Boardmasters! The iconic surf and music festival kicks off on Wednesday. Who are you excited to see?

angles.name: Summer vibes
angles.copy: Sun, surf, and sounds! Boardmasters Festival starts this Wednesday in Cornwall. Get ready for some serious summer vibes.

moments.title: UK Singles Chart #1 Revealed
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart this week with 'Rein Me In'.

angles.name: Chart topper
angles.copy: Your Official UK Singles Chart Number 1 is 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean! Still loving this one?

angles.name: Top 3 breakdown
angles.copy: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still at #1! Plus, Shakira & Burna Boy are at #2 with 'Dai Dai', and Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' rounds out the Top 3.

moments.title: Ricky Gervais' 'Alley Cats' on Netflix
moments.blurb: Ricky Gervais' new adult animated comedy series, 'Alley Cats', launches on Netflix next Friday, August 7th.

angles.name: New Gervais show
angles.copy: Get ready for some feral laughs! Ricky Gervais' new adult animated series 'Alley Cats' drops on Netflix next Friday. Expect his signature humour with a feline twist!

angles.name: What to watch
angles.copy: Looking for your next binge-watch? Ricky Gervais' 'Alley Cats' hits Netflix next week. A comedy about foul-mouthed feral cats – sounds purr-fectly chaotic.

moments.title: Happy 73rd to Robert Cray

angles.name: Blues icon
angles.copy: Happy 73rd Birthday to the incredible Robert Cray! What's your favourite blues track from this guitar master? #RobertCray

angles.name: Rock legend

angles.name: Metal icon
angles.copy: Metallica fans, get ready! James Hetfield turns 63 on Monday. What's the ultimate Metallica track to celebrate with? #JamesHetfield

angles.name: Spice Girl birthday

angles.name: Metal icon

angles.name: U2 legend
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to U2's iconic guitarist, The Edge, on Saturday! What's the U2 song you can't live without? #TheEdge

moments.title: North Wales Wildfire Alert
moments.blurb: North Wales remains on high alert for wildfires today, August 1st, after numerous deliberate fires in July, with authorities urging caution and reporting suspicious activity.

angles.name: Local warning
angles.copy: North Wales is still on high alert for wildfires. Please be extra careful in the countryside and report any suspicious activity immediately. Keep our beautiful landscape safe!

angles.name: Community safety
angles.copy: With dry conditions persisting, North Wales Fire and Rescue Service urges vigilance against wildfires. Let's all do our part to prevent fires.

moments.title: Devon to trial new EV chargers
moments.blurb: Devon is set to trial 30 new Government-funded on-street electric vehicle charging points starting this month, August 2026, to improve access for residents without off-street parking.

angles.name: Local EV news
angles.copy: Good news for EV drivers in Devon! A trial of 30 new on-street electric vehicle chargers is set to begin this month, making charging more accessible across the county.

angles.name: Green Devon
angles.copy: Devon is leading the way in green transport! New on-street EV chargers are being rolled out, helping us reduce emissions and support cleaner vehicles.

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City, will be held at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: Cardiff hosts football
angles.copy: Major football alert! The Community Shield clash between Arsenal and Manchester City is coming to Principality Stadium in Cardiff on August 16th!

angles.name: Football curtain-raiser
angles.copy: The traditional start to the football season is just over two weeks away! Arsenal face Manchester City in the Community Shield on August 16th. Who are you backing?

moments.title: European Athletics Championships
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships begin on Monday, August 10th, in Birmingham, marking the first time the UK has hosted this prestigious event.

angles.name: Athletics in UK
angles.copy: Get ready for track and field action! The European Athletics Championships kick off in Birmingham on August 10th. It's the first time the UK has hosted!

angles.name: Birmingham hosting
angles.copy: Birmingham welcomes Europe's elite athletes next week for the European Athletics Championships! Who are you hoping to see win gold?

moments.title: Mumbles Retro Week begins
moments.blurb: Mumbles Retro Week, a full week of music, nostalgia, and summer vibes, starts at Oystermouth Castle in Swansea on Thursday, August 7th.

angles.name: Retro Swansea
angles.copy: Take a trip down memory lane! Mumbles Retro Week kicks off next Thursday at Oystermouth Castle with a week of nostalgic music and fun.

angles.name: Summer nostalgia
angles.copy: Who's ready for some serious nostalgia? Mumbles Retro Week in Swansea starts next week, promising summer vibes and classic hits!

moments.title: UK Temperatures Set to Plunge
moments.blurb: After a heatwave, temperatures across parts of the UK, including Powys and Gwynedd in Wales, are predicted to plunge to as low as 7-9°C by Thursday, August 6th.

angles.name: Weather whiplash
angles.copy: From heatwave to chill! Parts of the UK could see temperatures drop significantly to single figures by next Thursday. Time to dig out those jumpers again?

angles.name: Wales weather
angles.copy: A dramatic shift in weather for Wales! After scorching temperatures, parts of Powys and Gwynedd could see lows of 7-9°C by Thursday. Stay warm!
